visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of seven young adults, including one female in the lead and six males behind her, stand in a studio setting against a large purple banner for an esports championship. The female is dressed in a black and white varsity jacket over a grey dress, while the males wear matching white and black team jerseys. (2) The group begins a synchronized dance routine. The female lead performs iconic hand gestures, specifically forming 'T' shapes with her fingers near her eyes, mimicking the 'TT' dance from a popular song. The males follow her lead with coordinated arm and body movements. (3) The female lead performs a playful jump and a 360-degree spin towards the left side of the frame as the dance sequence concludes. The camera follows her movement slightly. The males begin to break formation and move towards the background where chairs are visible as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional short featuring a popular influencer and the members of an esports team, Flash Wolves, participating in a viral dance challenge to promote the Arena of Valor International Championship. It leverages the popularity of the K-pop group Twice's 'TT' to build engagement and team branding.
